description: Source code for bot navigation and obstacle management in a game, including functions for setting navigation meshes, pathfinding, obstacle handling, and related utilities.

classes.name: Bot_t
classes.description: Structure representing a bot agent, including navigation data, pathfinding state, and obstacle info.

methods.name: G_BotSetNavMesh
methods.description: Sets the navigation mesh for a bot based on its class and updates its pathfinding filter.

methods.name: G_BotFindRoute
methods.description: Calculates a route for a bot to a specified target, allowing partial routes.

methods.name: G_IsBotOverNavcon
methods.description: Checks if a bot is currently over an off-mesh navigation connection.

methods.name: G_BotUpdatePath
methods.description: Updates the bot's current path and movement commands based on its target.

methods.name: BotFindRandomPointInRadius
methods.description: Finds a random navigable point within a radius around a given origin.

methods.name: G_BotNavTrace
methods.description: Performs a navigation mesh trace (raycast) to detect obstacles along a path.

methods.name: G_BotAddObstacle
methods.description: Adds a box obstacle to the navigation mesh at specified coordinates.

methods.name: G_BotRemoveObstacle
methods.description: Removes a previously added obstacle from the navigation mesh.

methods.name: G_BotUpdateObstacles
methods.description: Updates all obstacles in the navigation mesh, typically after changes.
